en:
The mastermind saw what was happening in
the library. They had <CLT=cltSTRONG>surveillance cameras<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
...SURVEILLANCE-CAMERAS?

Wh-What...? Where would...somethin'
like that be?

...You don't know, even though they're
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Monokubs<CLT=cltNORMAL> just like you?
Eh? Monokubs?
...I mean these.
Ohhh... So cute and tiny.
...Aren't they? They're your siblings, too.
That's a big reveal to drop so casually!

These little guys are called Nanokumas.
Their job is to monitor the campus.
HOW-DO-YOU-KNOW-THAT...?

Oh, Father told me! He said to make
sure I told everyone!

I had completely forgotten about it.
Good thing I just remembered!
Dumbass! You remembered too late!

There are countless Nanokumas buzzing
all over the campus.

All the footage they record is wirelessly
<CLT=cltSTRONG>transmitted through Motherkuma<CLT=cltNORMAL>...
and then sent to Monokuma.
Yes, via Motherkuma. That's an important point.

If Motherkuma receives the camera feeds,
the mastermind could ask it anything.

They would know about the situation
in the library and the hidden room.

I see! Motherkuma can tell them the
interval timers for the cameras!

Then the mastermind was in the hidden room
after they stole the Monopad from Rantaro.
But why would they steal the Monopad?

The mastermind was probably terrified by
the idea of us picking up Rantaro's perk.
No, that's wrong!
<CLT=cltMIND>...What?
I wasn't necessarily afraid...

The Survivor Perk was for Rantaro's eyes only.
Sure, he could've shared the info with you...

But that's not the same as getting the
info directly from the Monopad.

Cuz then, you can't say it was a Survivor
Perk for Rantaro's eyes only, right?

So when he died, I took it back.
That's all.
...I don't know about that.
Hm? How do you figure?

You look calm now...but at the time, you
must have been pretty desperate.

The Monopad clearly stated that there was
a <CLT=cltSTRONG>mastermind in the academy<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

If we knew then that a mastermind was behind
everything, we would have worked together.

But you couldn't let that happen.
You needed us to go after each other.

Either way, you admit the mastermind stole
the Monopad, right?
Well, yes... But only reluctantly.
Then the mastermind messed up!

If they wanted to retrieve the Monopad, 
they shoulda used Monokuma to do it!
Nope, that's impossible.

The rules state <CLT=cltSTRONG>I can't participate in a murder<CLT=cltNORMAL>,
which includes tampering with the crime scene.
<CLT=cltMIND>The school rules...

If you're so strict about following the rules,
does that mean that someone is watching?
If that's the case—
Still, what a waste of a Survivor Perk!

If only he lived a little longer, then this
info would've made things interesting!
Nyeh! Stop changing the subject!

<CLT=cltMIND>I still don't have the whole picture...
but it seems that we're all being watched.

<CLT=cltMIND>In that case...
this plan should go well.

<CLT=cltMIND>If I ruin this killing game by proving
that it doesn't follow its own rules...

<CLT=cltMIND>I should be able to
end the whole thing!

But the point of this class trial is to
discuss Rantaro's case, right?

The mastermind stealing his Survivor Perk
shouldn't affect it whatsoever.

In the end, Kaede killed him...
There's no shaking off that truth.
Yeah, yeah!
One truth prevails!

No, that's not the truth.
I'm certain of that.
It's a <CLT=cltSTRONG>lie<CLT=cltNORMAL> that you made up.
...Me? Lie?

That's right! Kaede wasn't the one who
killed Rantaro! The true culprit is...
Monokubs
The Monokubs!
Whaaat!? Us again!?

That can't be true! We're not allowed to
participate in a murder!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Monokuma
Monokuma!

I can't interfere! Cuz of the school rules
and all that jazz!

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Mastermind
Rantaro
It was Rantaro himself...

Huh? But Rantaro died cuz of Kaede's trap.
Therefore, the culprit is Kaede.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

There's no doubt that Kaede was the
culprit...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
<CLT=cltMIND>The real culprit that killed Rantaro...

...the <CLT=cltSTRONG>mastermind<CLT=cltNORMAL> controlling Monokuma!
They're the one who killed Rantaro!
The mastermind is the culprit!?

Geez... And you call yourself the Ultimate
Detective?

Tryin' to overturn the results of the first
class trial...
The Monokubs won't be silent about this!
Whaaat!? Us again!?
But we said we don't know!
